cleavage_agent: In solution without prior precipitation: 50 μL SPT solution was mixed with 200 μl Extraction buffer 2 of the ProteoExtract All-in-One Trypsin Digestion Kit and 200 μL 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate. Samples were then reduced with dithiothreitol (DTT) at 60 °C for 1 h, alkylated with iodoacetamide for 1 h at room temperature (RT) and digested with MS-grade trypsin at 37 °C
